secrets.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase service role key (bypasses RLS) from Supabase Dashboard → Settings → API. Needed for template remix and admin server functions; app boots and publishes sites without it.

secrets.name: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: Stripe secret key from dashboard.stripe.com → Developers → API keys. Needed for billing only.

secrets.name: STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET
secrets.description: Stripe webhook signing secret (whsec_…) from the webhook endpoint settings. Needed for billing only.

secrets.name: GITHUB_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID
secrets.description: GitHub OAuth app client ID from github.com → Settings → Developer settings → OAuth Apps. Needed for GitHub import/push only.

secrets.name: GITHUB_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET
secrets.description: GitHub OAuth app client secret. Needed for GitHub import/push only.

secrets.name: FORGE_SECRETS_ENCRYPTION_KEY
secrets.description: 64-char hex AES key used to encrypt per-project secrets. Generate with `openssl rand -hex 32`. Needed for the project secrets panel only.

secrets.name: FORGE_ADMIN_KEY
secrets.description: Admin API key for the Forge admin panel. Any strong random string. Needed for admin routes only.

secrets.name: FORGE_ADMIN_SESSION_SECRET
secrets.description: Session signing secret for admin auth. Any strong random string. Needed for admin routes only.
